sar.narrative: This report concerns suspected card-not-present fraud involving customer C05416 and card C05416-K1. On 2016-12-15 at 16:43:53, an online transaction of $200.07 was attempted for product code R from billing address 191. The transaction was flagged with a real-time risk score of 0.91 and a transaction model score of 1.000. While the amount was typical for the cardholder, the product code R had never been used before on this account. The activity is highly suspicious because it was conducted using a rare device profile, SAMSUNG SM-G965U Build/R16NW Android 8.0.0 samsung browser 7.0 2220x1081. This exact device profile was used on two other cards belonging to three other customers between 2016-12-13 and 2016-12-15, indicating a coordinated fraud effort. The transaction model also scored two of those other-card uses as fraud. The exposure for this specific transaction is $200.07, though the autonomous monitor noted a total of $999.97 across the shared device.
